item.title: After failed bills and resignations, Washington turns to AI safety
item.description: Jacob Coxon's resignation did not start this fight, but it marked the moment officials on both sides stopped staying quiet.

item.title: Meta bet AI would shrink management ranks; now it is rebuilding them
item.description: The company that told managers to code is now asking some engineers in a key AI division whether they want to lead teams again.

item.title: Venture capital uses 500,000 Pokémon cards as hedge against debt crisis
item.description: Peter Levin believes collectibles and trading cards will remain part of the alternative asset market.

item.title: Expert says technology can aid fluency but proficiency needs human interaction
item.description: Apps and AI can teach vocabulary and ease exchanges, but proficiency depends on handling situations beyond a script.
